pract-localised-repair-pmr.problem: isolated defect on an otherwise sound roof
pract-localised-repair-pmr.claim: A contained defect such as a local flashing problem or small damaged area can justify a targeted repair when the surrounding roof still has useful life.
pract-localised-repair-pmr.limitations: Commercial contractor guidance. The surrounding roof still needs competent assessment; a local symptom can originate elsewhere.

pract-sound-tired-restore-pmr.problem: weathered surface with fundamentally sound roof
pract-sound-tired-restore-pmr.claim: Restoration/recoating can be sensible when the roof system is fundamentally sound and the main issue is surface wear rather than widespread material failure.
pract-sound-tired-restore-pmr.limitations: Commercial contractor guidance. Coating suitability is roof-system and product dependent and must not be used to hide perforation, structural deterioration or failed details.

pract-widespread-replace-pmr.problem: widespread rust, failing sheets or persistent leaks
pract-widespread-replace-pmr.claim: Widespread deterioration or recurring failures across a roof are practitioner signals that repeated local repairs may offer poor long-term value compared with replacement.
pract-widespread-replace-pmr.limitations: Commercial contractor guidance. Replacement still requires site-specific condition and scope assessment.

pract-rrs-local-flashing-repair.problem: single leak associated with flashings and valley
pract-rrs-local-flashing-repair.claim: Roof Repair Specialists publishes a project example where one leak was treated by repairing two flashings and a valley rather than replacing the whole roof.
pract-rrs-local-flashing-repair.limitations: Publisher-reported project summary without an independent inspection report; illustrates proportional scope, not a universal diagnosis.

pract-rrs-sound-tile-repaint.problem: sound concrete tile roof with tired coating
pract-rrs-sound-tile-repaint.claim: Roof Repair Specialists publishes a Papakura project example where the concrete tile roof was considered structurally sound and repainting was recommended instead of reroofing.
pract-rrs-sound-tile-repaint.limitations: Publisher-reported project summary. The condition assessment and outcome have not been independently audited.

pract-decramastic-rust-through.problem: stone-chip loss, rust-through and multiple leaks
pract-decramastic-rust-through.claim: A Torbay case study reports an older Decramastic roof with widespread coating loss, rust-through and several leaks being stripped and replaced rather than patched.
pract-decramastic-rust-through.limitations: Publisher-reported case study. Age/lifespan claims in the source are not adopted by RoofHub without separate evidence.

pract-willymarsh-restoration-limit.claim: Willy Marsh Roofing says restoration should follow inspection and repairs, and that underlay, fixings or overall roof condition can make replacement the better investment.
pract-willymarsh-restoration-limit.limitations: Commercial contractor guidance; suitable coating system and roof condition remain project-specific.

pract-topline-hidden-purlins.claim: Topline Roofing reports a Mt Eden bungalow reroof where significant purlin deterioration was found only after the existing roof was stripped, leading to about 35 linear metres of purlin replacement.
pract-topline-hidden-purlins.limitations: Publisher-reported project quantity; useful to demonstrate opening-up risk, not to predict timber quantities on another roof.

pract-eh-hidden-reroof.problem: unknown conditions concealed by old roof
pract-eh-hidden-reroof.claim: Edwards & Hardy highlights damaged timber, deteriorated underlay, poor flashings and moisture issues as examples of problems that can become visible only when an old roof is removed.
pract-eh-hidden-reroof.limitations: Contractor interpretation of reroof risk. The underlying RANZ reroof guidance is preferred for industry-level requirements.

pract-hdk-mixed-age-hidden-timber.problem: roof sections of different ages with concealed timber deterioration
pract-hdk-mixed-age-hidden-timber.claim: HDK reports a Kumeu reroof with three separately built roof sections where timber deterioration was discovered after opening the roof, requiring selective purlin replacement/refastening.
pract-hdk-mixed-age-hidden-timber.limitations: Publisher-reported project. Product-selection claims in the source are not treated as independent manufacturer evidence.

pract-cowperthwaite-tile-restore.problem: aged concrete tile roof with cracked tiles and ridge maintenance
pract-cowperthwaite-tile-restore.claim: Cowperthwaite publishes a concrete-tile restoration project involving replacement of cracked tiles, full repointing, cleaning, sealing and coating rather than complete reroofing.
pract-cowperthwaite-tile-restore.limitations: Commercial restoration case study; warranty and longevity outcomes are provider-specific and are not generalised by RoofHub.

pract-homesmart-tile-local-repair.problem: cracked/displaced tiles or failed ridge/hip pointing
pract-homesmart-tile-local-repair.claim: HomeSmart describes individual tile replacement and ridge/hip repointing as proportional repairs when deterioration is local rather than widespread.
pract-homesmart-tile-local-repair.limitations: Commercial contractor guidance. Matching tile availability, underlay condition and wider roof condition can change the viable scope.

pract-homesmart-metal-partial-sheet.problem: isolated corroded sheets, fixings or flashings
pract-homesmart-metal-partial-sheet.claim: HomeSmart describes replacing individual deteriorated metal sheets, correcting fixings and repairing ridges/flashings/valleys without automatically replacing the entire roof.
pract-homesmart-metal-partial-sheet.limitations: Commercial practitioner guidance. Compatibility, remaining coating life and corrosion extent need on-site assessment.

pract-advance-replacement-bias.claim: Advance Roofing distinguishes isolated repairable defects from broader system deterioration, while also stating that its own business specialises in replacement rather than repairs.
pract-advance-replacement-bias.limitations: Commercial bias is explicit because the source does not offer repair work. RoofHub uses it only as a counter-perspective and does not adopt numeric age or repair-cost thresholds from the page.

pract-roofprotect-metal-recoat.problem: localised rust, loose fixings or worn coating
pract-roofprotect-metal-recoat.claim: Roof Protect describes localised minor rust, loose fixings and worn coating as potential repair/recoat work where the roof structure remains in reasonable condition.
pract-roofprotect-metal-recoat.limitations: Commercial restoration source. Coating cannot be assumed appropriate where corrosion has perforated the substrate or other roof-system failures remain.

pract-abovefocus-decramastic-local-repai.problem: persistent local leak on an older textured metal tile roof
pract-abovefocus-decramastic-local-repai.claim: Above Focus Roofing reports a Decramastic project where a persistent leak that had resisted earlier repair attempts was identified and resolved using local roof work that included replacement tiles rather than a whole-roof replacement.
pract-abovefocus-decramastic-local-repai.limitations: Publisher-reported project with no independent diagnostic record. The page does not establish asbestos status, remaining system life or whether the same local-repair approach would be safe or suitable on another older textured metal tile roof.

pract-roofrestore-torbay-tile.problem: weathered concrete tile roof with local tile, flashing and pointing defects but reportedly sound substrate
pract-roofrestore-torbay-tile.claim: Roof Restore reports a Torbay concrete-tile project where the substrate was considered structurally sound and cracked tiles, apron flashings and pointing were repaired before a restoration coating system was applied.
pract-roofrestore-torbay-tile.limitations: Commercial restoration case study and publisher-reported condition assessment. RoofHub does not generalise the source's life-extension, cost-comparison, coating-performance or warranty claims; those need independent product/system evidence and roof-specific inspection.
